desc: Light weight and minimalist, it's everything you need and nothing you don't. The G Sling comes equipped with our Sling Devils to attach the sling without having to use those big, clunky QD attachments or having to tie any knots. Remember, it takes 61 Sling Devils to equal the weight of just ONE QD sling attachment and cup. Lighter is better. If you don't believe us, find out yourself.
